Ticket #13 — Invoice Reconciliation

Difficulty: Medium

Context

You maintain invoice reconciliation for a finance tool. Reconciliation matches a payment notification to an invoice and updates its amount paid. A payment ID is the bank's reference for one remittance; repeating its notification must not count the funds twice. Amounts are in cents.

Practice report

Create inv-1 with total 10000 and paid amount 0. Apply apply_payment("pay-3", "inv-1", 4000) twice.

Observation after both notifications Current starter Expected
Invoice paid amount 8000 4000
Stored payment count for the invoice 1 1
Invoice status partial partial

Compare the paid amount with the actual saved remittance, rather than relying only on the number of records.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Positive installments accumulate against the remaining invoice balance. A smaller installment leaves partial; exact settlement changes it to paid.
  • Apply one payment reference at most once. An identical replay preserves the paid amount and payment record and returns the current partial/paid outcome.
  • With an existing target invoice and a positive amount, reusing a reference for different payment details returns conflict without replacing the original payment or changing either invoice.
  • Unknown invoices, nonpositive amounts, new payments against a paid invoice, and overpayments are rejected without invoice or payment-record changes.
  • The paid amount cannot exceed the invoice total, including across multiple notifications and retries.

Out of Scope

Use the existing local store and payment amounts. Bank integration, currency conversion, automatic refunds, and expanding amount-type validation are outside this ticket.

Investigation

Trace the duplicate report through the invoice and payment stores. Add focused tests for two installments that settle exactly, a replay, changed details under one reference, and an overpayment. Assert paid amounts and saved payment details after both accepted and rejected calls.
